Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1204 PM EST Thu Nov 19 2026
 

- Dry weather continues through Saturday with temperatures rising
  well above climatological normals.

- Next chance for rainfall arrives Sunday.

- Turning much colder Monday and continuing through most of next week
  with below normal temperatures.

&&

.AVIATION...

Southwest gradient flow increases this afternoon as low pressure 
over Ontario pushes up against the strong mid-Atlantic high. Breezy 
conditions expected this afternoon with gusts approaching 20-25 
knots before subsiding tonight as the boundary layer decouples. A 
brief opportunity exists for shallow fog Friday morning around 
sunrise as remnant moisture from a washed out frontal boundary moves 
into SE Michigan under otherwise clear skies. Gradient wind of 5-7 
knots however may be slightly too turbulent for the fog layer to 
settle in. Thus not high enough confidence to include BR/FG at any 
sites with this forecast package. Flow begins to back to the south-
southeast heading into Friday afternoon with any morning moisture 
quickly mixing out to VFR. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...
